desc:
Run, grow, and become a legendary Kitsune! 🏃‍♂️💨

👀 CODES : RELEASE , KITSUNE , SECRET , 50LIKES , 100LIKES

🏁 HOW TO PLAY
🏃 Run through the stages to gain Speed
💰 Touch the Win pads to collect Wins
🦊 Unlock powerful Kitsune transformations
🐾 Hatch eggs to collect pets that boost your gains
🏋️ Use the treadmills to multiply your Steps
🔄 Rebirth to start over with bigger bonuses
✨ Equip trails and show off your style

⚠️ Watch out! Some floors are deadly, and the sand rises in some zones.
💖 Died? Use Teleport Back to return to where you were!
👀 NEW CODES AT 200 LIKES !!
🌸 Stage by stage: Sakura, Beach, Snow, Wild West, Magma, Desert, and Space await!
